verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents a feature where an AI avatar interviews respondents, asks follow-ups, and organizes the results into an AI-generated report, so it produces AI insights from data collected in the product. That support is a single, thin claimed-docs mention. Other AI features, such as the AI Assistant turning prompts into videos, are content generation rather than insights from user data. Missing for 10: AI insights or suggestions over general workspace data such as video analytics or engagement, any detail on report contents or recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
